results.name: Modern Fence Set
results.description:
*Modern fence design combines aesthetics and functionality, aligning with contemporary architectural style.*

**Materials and Textures:** The design features wooden panels and concrete columns. The wooden panels create a warm and natural atmosphere, while the concrete columns provide durability and a modern look.

**Vertical and Horizontal Elements:** The black steel frames surrounding the wooden panels not only offer structural support but also add a minimalist and orderly aesthetic to the design.

**Gate Detail:** The gate section includes a numbering detail that harmonizes with the overall design of the fence, making it both functional and personalized.

**Environmental Harmony:** Grass or stone details placed at the base of the fence demonstrate the structure’s seamless integration with its natural surroundings.

results.name: Hillside Retreat | Concrete House Concept
results.description:
This modern hillside retreat is a bold expression of minimalist architecture, designed to harmonize with its natural surroundings. Perched on an elevated slope, the structure features clean concrete forms, expansive glazing, and cantilevered upper levels that emphasize openness and light.

Key features include:

Sleek, monolithic geometry for a striking visual impact

Floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic views

Elevated platforms supported by slender columns to preserve the terrain

Spacious terraces blending indoor and outdoor living

Designed for both serenity and sophistication, this concept explores the balance between brutalist elements and refined contemporary living. Ideal for visualization, architectural showcases, or as inspiration for real-world builds.

results.name: Hampstead Garden Suburb Free Church
results.description:
**Hampstead Garden Suburb Free Church (London, UK)**

Sir Edwin Lutyens’s Grade I–listed Free Church anchors Central Square in Hampstead Garden Suburb, opposite St Jude-on-the-Hill. The building combines brick with stone dressings and a low domed crossing; its dome, beams and columns are reinforced concrete—an elegant modern structure wrapped in classical restraint. Construction began on 16 January 1911 and the church opened on 25 October 1911. This model was captured by drone in August 2025.

Location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/RVD55zSChTjjxUAfA

Panorama: https://maps.app.goo.gl/HSon54dfHcDj8wbn8

results.name: Phraya Samantaratburin Residence, Thailand
results.description:
A wood-and-concrete house (MAHS-THA-STN-MUS-PHM-S-003-F-0001) oriented east-west, with its main entrance facing west. Originally built as an elevated one-story residence on concrete columns, the space below was later enclosed for secure storage. The rectangular plan includes western and eastern sections linked by a roofed hallway, plus a rear extension. The western quarter was the main residence, while the eastern contains enclosed rooms. Designed for natural ventilation, the shaded central hallway serves as the most comfortable communal space.

For open-access to our complete dataset of archaeological sites and historical artifacts from the Maldives, Indonesia, and Thailand, please visit us at: https://maritimeasiaheritage.cseas.kyoto-u.ac.jp
